name: Omaherdr
author: Neil Patel
description: TUI-style panel for herdr: live agents and spaces, persistent attention across attached machines and opt-in saved machines, and one keypress to jump to an available target.

barWidget.description: Agents waiting for input or done in the bar; a panel for live agents, spaces and persistent attention across attached machines and opt-in saved machines, with safe jumps to available targets.

schema.label: Lights shown beside the icon
schema.description: attention = red (needs input) and green (done); active = also yellow (working); all = also grey (idle); none = icon only, with the lit lights stacked beside it. Counts are hidden when zero.

schema.label: How the lights are drawn
schema.description: lights = a small square beside each count; inverse = the count on a pill in the state's colour (icon-only mode paints the colours behind the icon).

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: A name (robot, robot-happy, console, terminal, brain, group, dashboard, flag, bell, server, lan, chip, pulse) or any Nerd Font glyph.

schema.label: Panel view
schema.description: agents = one row per agent, most urgent first; spaces = every space with its tabs; attention = pending input, completions and unavailable saved connections until they resolve.

schema.label: Desktop alerts
schema.description: Opt in to generic desktop alerts when an agent needs input or finishes. Alerts never include prompt or transcript text.

schema.label: Alert when agents finish
schema.description: Include completed agents when desktop alerts are enabled.

schema.label: Seconds to group completions
schema.description: Wait briefly so agents finishing together in one workspace can share one alert.

schema.label: Snooze duration in minutes
schema.description: How long the selected attention item stays snoozed without changing its Herdr state.

schema.label: Quiet hours start
schema.description: Optional 24-hour HH:MM time. Leave either quiet-hours field empty, or set both equal, to disable quiet hours.

schema.label: Quiet hours end
schema.description: Optional 24-hour HH:MM time. Overnight ranges are supported.

schema.label: Watch saved machines
schema.description: Opt in to background monitoring of enabled saved machine profiles, including ones not currently attached to this desktop.

schema.label: Seconds between scans for herdr sessions
schema.description: How often the daemon looks for herdr clients starting or stopping. Agent status itself is pushed by herdr, so this only affects how quickly a new or closed session shows up.

schema.label: Preferred terminal for jumps
schema.description: When more than one terminal window hosts the same herdr server, jump to the one whose window class contains this (kitty, foot, alacritty, ghostty, wezterm). auto = pick by herdr's window title, then the current workspace, then most recent focus.
